5838.title: [Skia] Sync m157 Vulkan descriptor-pool fix
5838.body:
[Skia] Sync m157 Vulkan descriptor-pool fix (#5838)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/468
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5858
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/51cb594d773b5383a45065ea3c8cbec398ad2c36...2d1eb2a417b039035671671ac998ec8fbf3b4c95

Bring the chrome/m157 Vulkan servicing fix into the 4.157 release line
without changing package versions, the native ABI or managed bindings.

~~ Avoid unsafe descriptor-pool destruction on Imagination ~~

On Imagination drivers, a host or device OOM from vkAllocateDescriptorSets
can leave a pool that cannot safely be destroyed. Ganesh may destroy it
before marking the context lost, and Graphite does not yet mark its context
lost on OOM.

The upstream fix deliberately abandons the affected pool on those errors in
Ganesh and Graphite, preventing vkDestroyDescriptorPool from running on it.
Graphite also rejects subsequent allocations through the null pool handle.
The workaround trades pool cleanup for safety on the affected drivers.

~~ Record the landed native merge without changing reviewed content ~~

Pin externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to native merge
2d1eb2a417b039035671671ac998ec8fbf3b4c95, and record chrome/m157 at
174579d74ec7dcf88e61d01a221eebc0cfb2c246. The native merge has two parents,
contains reviewed commit c2f0aeef3046bea5b159ac517e31464f43023c64, and has
an identical tree, preserving the reviewed source while recording the landed
ancestry.

The sync PR reports a passing Linux x64 native source build, unchanged
regenerated bindings, a managed build and the unfiltered console solution.
The ancestry-only repin does not constitute a new runtime test.
